title: Strong-Bruhat-minimal elements are exactly minimum-length representatives in involution-fixed parabolic Coxeter cosets
author: Chapelier-Laget, Nathan; Gobet, Thomas
work: Elements of minimal length and Bruhat order on fixed point cosets of Coxeter groups
difficulty_reason: The proof handles nonreflection generators of involution-fixed parabolic subgroups by an exact equal-length or Bruhat-increase dichotomy, then uses a lifting lemma to propagate a minimal representative along every reduced fixed-group word. The key inversion-set and dihedral cases are supplied fully, beyond ordinary standard-parabolic coset theory.

source_check.note: The selected problem is original Theorem1.3 only, with the exact nontrivial existential/bidirectional meaning: for every x in W there is a minimum-length w in its involution-fixed parabolic coset with w<=x in strong Bruhat order; equivalently every Bruhat-minimal coset element has minimum length as well. No unique minimum or universal comparison from every shortest representative is asserted. Full author Sections1--4 retain theta^2=id, the fixed-group longest-orbit generators, complete inversion/dihedral equal-length-versus-increase dichotomy, lifting lemma and full induction434--444.
